messages:
marisol: Quick sync — triage criteria + incentive options for the pilot cohort. Need final decisions by Fri.

sandeep: How many seats do we want to commit? Ops said 8-12 GPUs available. Is that 20 active pilot seats or fewer?

anya: Thinking capacity + signal quality. Proposed rubric:
```
- Must: production contact, >1M monthly users OR enterprise use-case
- Prefer: prior infra/policy constraints (VPC/onprem)
- Redflag: PII/legal blockers they won't sign NDA
- Score: 0-4 on POI, ROI, infra-readiness, compliance
```

devon: Incentive options:
- $1k stipend
- $2k cloud credits
- Dedicated onboarding + SLA for 3 months
Which is easiest for finance? Also need legal ok on stipend.

olivia: For feedback cadence recommendation: 30m weekly sync for first 4 weeks, then biweekly. Async: short survey (3 q) + sample prompt/regression checklist after every deploy.

marisol: Draft outreach template (editable):
```
Hi {{name}},
We'd love to invite you to a limited pilot for Redwood's private inference flow. You'll get early access, priority support, $2k credits (or stipend), and direct influence on roadmap. If interested, fill this short form: https://forms.example/pilot
```

pilot-bot: New sign-up: AcmeMedia — contact: jane@acme — infra: VPC — score: 9

sandeep: Nice. We should cap geo diversity: 60% NA, 30% EU, rest APAC. Also require a small acceptance test: 3 example workloads + latency SLA check in staging.

anya: Gating metrics idea:
- baseline perf: 95th pct latency < 400ms for typical prompt
- quality: no >5% regression vs baseline eval suite
- engagement: at least 2 feedbacks per sprint
Link to eval harness: https://internal/redwood/evals

marisol: Action items:
- @devon run finance on credits vs stipend by Wed
- @sandeep draft acceptance test + staging runbook
- @olivia finalize survey + sync cadence doc
I'll schedule 30m Wed for sign-off (invite to follow). :thumbsup:

devon: On it. talking to finance now. ETA Wed EOD.

olivia: I'll drop the survey draft in #product-docs and ping you all. 

marisol: Thanks team — let's keep the pool small and high-signal. Will post final sweep before Fri.
